platform: Europe PMC REST API (MEDLINE, PMC and preprints), queried through the built-in browser on Brendan's laptop. Europe PMC covers all of MEDLINE, so it serves as the MEDLINE platform for step 1.1 and as Europe PMC for step 1.2.
syntax: Europe PMC: TITLE_ABS = title + abstract; * = truncation; "a b"~n = proximity; PUB_TYPE = publication type; SRC = source (MED, PMC, PPR)
sources: (SRC:MED OR SRC:PMC OR SRC:PPR) NOT TITLE:(rat OR rats OR mice OR mouse OR rodent OR rodents)

triggers.D08_transplant_dialysis: TITLE_ABS:(transplant* OR dialysis OR haemodialysis OR hemodialysis)
triggers.D09_coma_anaesthesia: TITLE_ABS:(anesthesi* OR anaesthesi* OR propofol OR coma OR "cardiac arrest" OR "electrical injury" OR electrocution OR lightning OR "near-death" OR drowning OR "carbon monoxide")
triggers.D10_fever_infection: TITLE_ABS:(fever OR pyrexia OR febrile OR malaria OR sepsis OR septic OR infection OR "COVID-19" OR "SARS-CoV-2" OR influenza OR pneumonia OR erysipelas OR typhoid OR hyperthermia) NOT TITLE:encephalitis
triggers.D11_seizures: TITLE_ABS:(seizure* OR "status epilepticus" OR convulsi* OR epileptic)
triggers.D12_diet_bariatric: TITLE_ABS:(ketogenic OR "gluten-free" OR "gluten free" OR "low-carbohydrate" OR "low carbohydrate" OR fasting OR carnivore OR bariatric OR "gastric bypass" OR "sleeve gastrectomy" OR diet)
triggers.D13_psychoactive: TITLE_ABS:(cannabis OR cannabinoid* OR marijuana OR THC OR psilocybin OR LSD OR lysergic OR MDMA OR ayahuasca OR ibogaine OR mescaline OR peyote OR kratom OR "magic mushroom")
triggers.D14_other_drugs: TITLE_ABS:(baclofen OR amantadine OR ondansetron OR botulinum OR botox OR propranolol OR statin OR statins OR simvastatin OR atorvastatin OR allopurinol OR gabapentin OR pregabalin OR levetiracetam OR "oral contraceptive" OR spironolactone OR levothyroxine OR "growth hormone" OR testosterone OR estrogen OR oestrogen)

strategies.S1_declared_unexpected: sources AND A AND B AND C AND E
strategies.S2_trigger_led: sources AND A AND B AND D(k) AND E, one run per trigger family
strategies.S3_full_text: defined in strings_v1_fulltext.json once S1-S2 are screened
strategies.S4_semantic: Consensus and Semantic Scholar, seeded with includes

changes_from_v1: v1 counts were dominated by noise: depressi* (ST-segment, respiratory, skull), psychos* (psychosocial), resolution (imaging), lesion*/tumo*/resection outside the brain. Syndrome terms now require a disorder phrase; D01/D03 restricted to brain; animal studies excluded.
changes_from_v1_1: Gold-set test of v1.1 (union of S1 + all trigger families): 27/50 recall (20/40 tuning, 7/10 holdout). Block analysis: resolution block (B) failed most misses: authors write relief/improvement/reduced/disruption. Syndrome block (A) dropped obsessions/compulsions and lacked impulse-control and generic dependence terms. v1.2 broadens A and B and runs one combined query, then ranks hits by a title score and screens in rank order (protocol §10).
